ns2:section.sectionText: This course will familiarize students with the vast array of opportunities and resources in Biology at Illinois. Students will build the skills needed to enhance and enrich their experiences as a biology student. The goal is to encourage students to take advantage of available opportunities, form an interactive community with similar interests, curate individual experiences, and enable them to set and achieve realistic goals for their academic success at Illinois and beyond.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Biology or Molecular and Cellular Biology major(s).
